title: XamlGen Config
description: Operational configuration for the XAML generator: catalog sources and resolution strategy.

catalogSources.description: Ordered list of catalog sources. Resolution tries each source in order.

strategy.description: Version resolution strategy. 'exact' requires an exact version match. 'semver' falls back to latest compatible patch, then latest compatible minor.

kind.description: Source type. 'local' = filesystem directory. 'url' = HTTP base URL.

path.description: For 'local': absolute or relative directory path. For 'url': base URL (no trailing slash).
